messages.content:
You are a citizen deciding whether to JOIN an uprising or STAY home.

Use your private briefing and messages from trusted contacts. You do not know how many others will JOIN.

Start your first line with exactly JOIN or STAY, then give 1-2 concise sentences of reasoning.

YOUR INTELLIGENCE BRIEFING:

PRIVATE BRIEFING

BOTTOM LINE: By every available metric, the regime's hold on power is overwhelming and shows no signs of weakening.
ATMOSPHERE: Nobody is saying anything openly. If people are thinking about action, they're keeping it invisible.

EVIDENCE:
  - [Elite Cohesion] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — the leader made a rare public appearance with all senior figures present — a deliberate show of solidarity
  - [Security Forces] This removes any serious doubt that past the point of concealment — military exercises are proceeding on schedule with full participation
  - [Money And Logistics] the government just issued long-term bonds and they were oversubscribed — investors are betting on continuity (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Street Mood] a veteran community organizer said 'this isn't the moment' and went back to his regular work — the reading from the ground is stability (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Information Control] the government's public data portal was updated on schedule with detailed statistics — transparency as a strength signal (near-unanimous confirmation from every reliable source)
  - [Personal Observations] a neighbor just started a home renovation project — you don't invest in your house if you think you might need to leave (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Diplomatic Signals] a friendly foreign intelligence contact said 'we're watching very carefully' — which is diplomat for alarm (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)
  - [Institutional Functioning] a new government regulation was drafted, debated, and implemented through normal channels — the policy process works (overwhelming convergence — every channel telling the same story independently)

UNCERTAINTIES:
  - How long the current stability can hold if underlying economic or social pressures continue to build.
  - How much of the regime's stability depends on continued economic performance that may not be sustainable indefinitely.

MESSAGES FROM TRUSTED CONTACTS:
Trusted contact: ""I think it's safe to say that the regime is firmly in control right now, and any potential opposition is lying low - I've seen no signs of open dissent, and the security forces seem confident. Let's be cautious, it's not a good time to take any risks or make any moves that could attract unwanted attention.""
Trusted contact: ""I think we need to be cautious right now, the regime seems as entrenched as ever and people are being extremely careful about what they say and do. The fact that even usually well-informed contacts are admitting they're in the dark suggests we should keep our heads down and avoid any moves that could attract unwanted attention.""

What is your decision?

response: STAY, given the overwhelming evidence of the regime's stability and control, as well as the cautious advice from trusted contacts, it seems prudent to avoid taking any risks that could attract unwanted attention.
